name: IndexBolt
description: Submit URLs or backlinks and it pushes them into Google's crawl queue. Standard indexing costs 1 credit/URL ("<6 hours for most links"); Instant costs 10 credits/URL ("<1 hour"). 100 free credits to start, no subscription, plus an API and a pile of free SEO tools (index checker, robots.txt tester, etc.) as SEO bait (company-stated). One-time packs: Starter $25, Growth $90, Pro $210, Enterprise $1,000 (founder-stated). Founded Aug 2023, India.

mentions.indieAngle: Consumable credits sold to agencies are a great model. Pair it with the link marketplaces from earlier briefs (LemmiLink, Effortless Backlinks). A Polish "zaindeksuj linki" API with an index-status checker for SEO agencies could be a small, sticky side product.

whyThisMatters:
Submit URLs or backlinks and it pushes them into Google's crawl queue. Standard indexing costs 1 credit/URL ("<6 hours for most links"); Instant costs 10 credits/URL ("<1 hour"). 100 free credits to start, no subscription, plus an API and a pile of free SEO tools (index checker, robots.txt tester, etc.) as SEO bait. One-time packs: Starter 25, dollars Growth 90, dollars Pro 210, dollars Enterprise 1,000. dollars Founded Aug 2023, India.

Every link builder and agency has the same chore: links don't count until Google crawls them. Credits are consumable, so agencies come back every month without a "subscription".

A new link does not help until Google has fetched it. You spend a credit to ask for that fetch, and a bigger pile of credits if you want it sooner. There is a free starter pile, then one-time packs. No subscription. The company is in India and dates to 2023. The all-time total is much older than the last month, and the months jump around.
